test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six friends are sitting around a round table facing the centre with equal distances between two neighbours. Sarah is sitting to the immediate left of Laura. Ron is sitting second to the right of Tyler. Sarah is sitting third to the left of Adam. Laura is sitting to the immediate left of Tyler. Tessa is sitting to the immediate right of Ron. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Sarah?
solution:
Given: Six friends are sitting around a round table facing the centre with equal distances between two neighbours.

1) Sarah is sitting to the immediate left of Laura.

2) Sarah is sitting third to the left of Adam. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eecf35ac157ed4e5447541a5d306b43fde1e8386472ffd59b91e62f46b20edd3.png] 

3) Laura is sitting to the immediate left of Tyler.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40cd23f0009ae934793a9da88368cbee20c21c1a9c713e3c08381e2f4321c1f7.png] 

4) Ron is sitting second to the right of Tyler. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0697174ff7e2c39997f39d213234cda2854139e1eacf47b6f6818eefff5bce4b.png] 

5) Tessa is sitting to the immediate right of Ron.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65062276d9cd6c70b010d882ac65126c80d390117cd1cfda65fbbb13ea5bf30e.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Tessa is sitting to the immediate left of Sarah.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
